artworks.title: The Seven Chiefs against Thebes
artworks.description: Salon canvas (Musée des Beaux-Arts d'Angers, MBA J 140): Adrastus and the six champions swear over a black bull before Thebes, vowing to restore Polynices. Mongez's 1827 livret names Adraste as the Argive king who gathers Tydeus, Amphiaraus, Capaneus, Hippomedon and Parthenopaeus for the doomed march.

artworks.title: Adrastos in His Chariot (Attic amphoriskos, MET 19.192.44)
artworks.description: Attic red-figure amphoriskos in the Metropolitan Museum (Rogers Fund, 1919; inv. 19.192.44): Adrastos, king of Argos, drives his chariot with his name inscribed on the vase. Classical pottery gives the leader of the Seven a labelled portrait — the host who married his daughters to Polynices and Tydeus and led the Argive army to Thebes.

artworks.title: The Oath of the Seven Chiefs
artworks.artist: Unknown (Project Gutenberg plate after classical tradition)
artworks.description: Nineteenth-century book plate of the Seven swearing before Thebes — the covenant Adrastus seals as Argive king and father-in-law of Polynices. Popular illustration keeps Adrastus at the centre of the Theban war's opening rite, the oath that Aeschylus and Statius both stage.

artworks.title: The Oath of the Seven Chiefs against Thebes
artworks.description: Neoclassical drawing in the Cleveland Museum of Art (2000.71): the Seven swear their pact before Thebes under Adrastus' command. Girodet freezes the Argive king's war-band at the altar — the oath that binds Polynices' allies and opens the campaign Adrastus alone will survive.

popCulture.title: Seven Against Thebes
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: Aeschylus stages the Argive assault Adrastus leads for Polynices — the king of Argos whose seven champions die at the seven gates.

popCulture.title: The Suppliants
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides brings Adrastus to Athens as a broken suppliant: the Argive king who lost his army and begs Theseus to bury the Seven.

popCulture.title: Thebaid
popCulture.creator: Statius
popCulture.description: Statius' epic fills the war Adrastus hosted: Tydeus and Polynices under his roof, the march on Thebes, and the Argive defeat that still names him.
